title: 16-Inch Glass Shelf With Towel Bar (Solid Brass) | Mediterranean Blue | Waverly Place Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Need more bathroom storage without giving up counter space? This wall-mounted glass shelf adds organized, easy-to-reach storage while the integrated towel bar keeps towels ready at the sink or shower in Mediterranean Blue, which presents a deep, sophisticated blue with subtle purple undertones, evoking the rich depths of coastal waters for a bold yet refined statement.

  • Mediterranean Blue transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Keep towels within reach: Integrated towel bar is ideal for guest baths and daily routines.
  • Clean, finished installation: Concealed screw mounting hardware.
  • Coordinate the look: Part of the Waverly Place collection for matching Waverly Place transitional bath accessories and transitional bathroom hardware.

Specs & Installation

  • Overall size: 16-Inch L x 5-Inch W
  • Projection: 5 Inches
  • Height: 12 Inches
  • Glass thickness: 0.38 Inches (3/8-Inch)
  • Weight capacity: 4 lb
  • Material: Brass (hardware)
  • Mounting: Wall mount; concealed screw installation
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware (screw size: #8 x 1 1/4")
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

_previous.title: 16 Inch Gallery Double Glass Shelf with Towel Bar
_previous.description: Add a flare of style to your décor with this decorative glass shelf. Shelf can be used anywhere in the home for a great space to store your products. Gallery rail will keep your items secure while the integrated towel bar provides a creative space for your towels. Tempered glass is 3/8 Inches thick and all of the hardware is made of solid brass and finished with the highest quality materials to provide a lifetime of beauty.
